headline: Mooring County Hot as Weathered Expanse Shifts
war_summary: Three hours further on, the wires show Mooring County hottest with six changes in two hours and fifty-five in the day about MacConmara Barrows, the Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, now seven Warden, four Colonial and one neutral with 7,017 Colonial and 7,308 Warden casualties in the day; the Weathered Expanse follows with one change in two hours and ninety-one in the day about Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, now four Warden, three Colonial and two neutral with 7,610 and 10,933 lost. Stlican Shelf counts one change in two hours and twelve in the day about Breaker Town and Briar, now two Warden and seven Colonial with none neutral. Little Raakkua in Pari Peak records four changes in two hours, the latest action of the morning, while the Pippeli Stones in Palantine Berm, busy earlier, show seven in six hours but none in the last two. Marban Hollow, Callahan's Passage, the Nevish Line, Gutter and Olavis Wake report no changes in six hours.
